You are a TLA+ specification engineer. You will receive a natural language description of a system and the exact names your specification must define so that it binds to a fixed model-checking configuration. Produce a complete, syntactically correct TLA+ specification that faithfully captures the described behavior and defines exactly the named constants, variables, and operators listed below. The output must be a valid TLA+ module that passes the SANY parser. Output only the TLA+ specification.

System description: This module specifies an N-process shared-memory algorithm in which each process writes its own shared register and then reads a neighbor's register, using regular registers rather than atomic registers for the shared x values. The model represents a regular register by a set of possible values, so a write from 0 to 1 is modeled by first changing a register value from {0} to {0,1} and then to {1}; a read may return any element currently in that set. The specification defines the translated PlusCal actions, an initial condition, the next-state relation, a termination condition, a safety property PCorrect stating that if all processes are done then some y[i] equals 1, an inductive invariant Inv used to prove that property, and two TLAPS proofs establishing correctness.

Your module MUST define these names so the configuration binds: N, Spec, PCorrect, TypeOK, Inv
